visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short reddish-brown hair, wearing a red checkered shirt and a dark apron, is seen from a medium close-up shot focusing on a small green bonsai plant. She is using her hands and scissors to work on the leaves. The setting is a brightly lit indoor space with shelves holding various small pots in the background. (2) An older man with graying hair tied in a topknot and glasses, wearing a dark apron over a black t-shirt, is meticulously wrapping a thin black wire around the stem of a similar bonsai plant. He is focused, looking down through his glasses. (3) A woman in a white t-shirt reaches into the frame to point at a specific branch on the plant the man is holding. The man looks up with a slightly concerned facial expression as they discuss the delicate 'tender branch' area. (4) Close-up shot of the man's face as he exhibits a startled and worried expression, his mouth slightly open, while he continues to hold the plant. A yellow variety-style text bubble appears next to him. (5) The young woman in the red checkered shirt is shown again, now smiling brightly and holding her plant, which has been shaped into a distinct heart-like form. She makes a fist-pump gesture. (6) The woman in the white t-shirt explains the shaping process, gesturing with her hands towards a bonsai. The man listens attentively. The lighting remains bright and even, highlighting the textures of the leaves and the wires. (7) The older man presents his finished bonsai work to the camera, tilting it from side to side to show the new curved shape of the main stem. He has a playful and proud expression. (8) The video concludes with the young woman in red holding her completed heart-shaped bonsai, smiling at the camera in a medium shot.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy electronic pop BGM begins with a prominent drum beat. A male voice speaks rapidly with high arousal, welcoming viewers to the session. (2) Ambient room tone is minimal. The male voice shifts to a lower, hesitant tone, expressing concern about a possible breakage. A high-pitched female voice responds supportively. (3) A distinct 'SNAP' sound effect occurs, followed by an immediate 'Impact' SFX for comedic emphasis. Collective laughter from three distinct voices follows. (4) The female instructor's voice (clear articulation) takes over, explaining technical steps at a moderate pace. The background BGM dips slightly in volume. (5) Upbeat music swells as the female participant's voice rises in pitch and volume, celebrating the 'perfect' result. (6) A transition features a 'Whoosh' SFX. The male voice returns, speaking in a mock-serious tone, then switches to Japanese phrases with an exaggerated, comedic inflection. (7) Funny/quirky BGM replaces the pop track during the presentation of the plant. The male voice continues a playful commentary. (8) The audio concludes with a final cheerful chorus of voices and a bright, stinger-like musical flourish.
